assign.outcome:
**Three feeds shipped at /imagine/feeds/, each verdicted and headless-verified at 400/1920/3440.**

[Feeds index](/imagine/feeds/) - previews as nav, three cards.

**[Video](/imagine/feeds/video/)** - inbox-pattern picker (5 verified real TED/Stanford talks) beside a 16:9 lazy stage. Verdict: zero iframes until the poster is clicked, one correct `youtube-nocookie.com` iframe after - proven headless, not just described.

**[Data](/imagine/feeds/data/)** - `data.json` (20 real buildings) fetched once, filtered once, read by three children: [Cards](/imagine/feeds/data/cards/), [Tree](/imagine/feeds/data/tree/) (group->item->detail, local state), [Table](/imagine/feeds/data/table/). Verdict: controls over files - one text box + one chip row drives all three, zero per-view filter code. Numbers: 20 total, search "Paris" -> 3, facet "skyscraper" -> 5, facet "bridge" -> 2.

**[Live](/imagine/feeds/live/)** - one keyless Open-Meteo fetch, 5 cities, one request (comma-separated lat/lon). Verdict: the honest-failure path is one `.catch()` and one class - verified with the network route-blocked: quiet `.feeds-offline` note, zero rows, never a blank column.

Zero console errors on every page; the one exception is the deliberately-network-blocked tab, where the only two lines are that fetch's own `net::ERR_FAILED`.

Docs: [readme.md](/imagine/feeds/readme.md) style index, [doc/decisions.md](/imagine/feeds/doc/decisions.md) full record. `feeds-` added to css-scopes.txt.

**Left out:** no localStorage persistence for the data filter or tree selection (per-visit only, matching the site's existing column-resize convention); no second live API (one was asked for); video captions/transcripts not fetched (would need a second API).
